why.heading: Built for Garissa, by people who understand Garissa
why.para1: GarissaConnect exists to make life easier for residents, strengthen local businesses and give every person — regardless of background — a fair chance to discover and act on opportunities.
why.para2: We believe access to information should never depend on who you know or where you live.
why.value1Desc: Bringing together residents, organizations and businesses in one shared space.
why.value2Desc: Making jobs, scholarships and training visible to everyone, not just a few.
why.value3Desc: Helping Garissa businesses reach more customers and grow sustainably.
why.value4Desc: Useful information and resources that used to be hard to find, now in one place.
why.value5Desc: Encouraging more residents to participate in the digital economy.

about.heroHeading1: A digital hub built for the
about.heroSubhead: GarissaConnect is a community-driven platform that connects residents of Garissa County with opportunities, local businesses, services, events and the information that matters most.
about.missionText: To make useful information and real opportunities accessible to every resident of Garissa County — regardless of their background, location or level of digital experience.
about.visionText: A digitally connected Garissa where every person can discover, participate and grow — and where local businesses and organizations thrive alongside the community they serve.
about.storyPara1: For years, information about jobs, scholarships, training, community events and local services has been spread across notice boards, WhatsApp groups, social media pages and word of mouth. Useful — but fragmented.
about.storyPara2: GarissaConnect was created to bring all of this together in one trusted, easy-to-use platform. A place where residents can discover what is happening, businesses can be seen, and community information is accessible to everyone.
about.storyPara3: This is not just a website. It is a shared digital space for the Garissa community — designed to grow with the people it serves.
about.storyPointsHeading: What we set out to fix
about.storyPoint1: Opportunities existed, but were hard to find in one place.
about.storyPoint2: Local businesses needed a stronger digital presence.
about.storyPoint3: Community information was scattered across many channels.
about.storyPoint4: Residents deserved a platform designed around their needs.
about.whatWeDoHeading: Four pillars that hold the platform together
about.whatWeDoSubhead: Everything on GarissaConnect fits into one of these four areas — designed to serve residents, businesses and the community as a whole.
about.pillar1Desc: Jobs, internships, scholarships and training — made visible to every resident.
about.pillar2Desc: A digital home for Garissa businesses to be discovered and supported.
about.pillar3Desc: Meetups, workshops, announcements and updates from across the county.
about.pillar4Desc: Guides, documents and useful information gathered in one trusted place.
about.valuesHeading: The principles that shape everything we build
about.valuesSubhead: GarissaConnect is not just software. It is a commitment to the community — and these five values guide every decision we make.
about.value1Desc: Every decision starts with one question: does this help residents of Garissa?
about.value2Desc: Simple navigation, clear language and multiple languages so no one is left behind.
about.value3Desc: Information is verified, kept current, and presented with clarity.
about.value4Desc: Built for Garissa — for its people, its businesses, and its everyday realities.
about.value5Desc: We build slowly and carefully so the platform can serve the community for years.
about.journeyHeading: From an idea to a growing community platform
about.journeySubhead: Every milestone has been built carefully — listening to the community, improving the platform, and taking one deliberate step at a time.
about.journeyM1Desc: Residents of Garissa identified a simple problem: information was everywhere, but not in one place. The idea for a community digital hub took shape.
about.journeyM2Desc: Months of conversations with residents, students, business owners and community leaders shaped what the platform needed to be.
about.journeyM3Desc: GarissaConnect launched with opportunities, businesses and community information. Early users began finding real value on day one.
about.journeyM4Desc: Hundreds of residents joined. Local businesses began listing their services. Community announcements found a reliable home.
about.journeyM5Desc: We are expanding the platform — new languages, voice access, USSD and SMS support — so every resident, on every device, can participate.
about.impactSubhead: Real numbers from a platform that is growing with the Garissa community every week.
about.teamSubhead: A small, dedicated group working to build a platform that truly serves the Garissa community.

about.member4Bio: Connecting GarissaConnect with local businesses, county offices and community partners.
